b2-32-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Too Tired to Stand
b2-32-01.scenario: In the empty stadium, the goalkeeper asks you, next to Esterházy Péter, how tired the marathon runner was at the end.
b2-32-01.prompt: Tell the goalkeeper how tired the runner was.
cues: Say how tired the runner was
Say what he could hardly do
b2-32-01.target: A futó olyannyira kimerült, hogy alig tudott talpon maradni.
b2-32-01.english: The runner was so exhausted that he could hardly stay on his feet.
b2-32-01.canDo: I can form consecutive clauses of extreme degree using olyannyira ..., hogy

b2-32-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Winger Did
b2-32-02.scenario: Esterházy Péter asks you what the winger did in last night's match.
b2-32-02.prompt: Tell Esterházy what the winger did to the defender and to the goalkeeper.
cues: Say what he did to the defender
Say what he did to the goalkeeper
b2-32-02.target: A szélső lefutotta a védőt, és kicselezte a kapust.
b2-32-02.english: The winger outran the defender and dribbled past the goalkeeper.
b2-32-02.canDo: I can describe rapid athletic maneuvers using dynamic aspectual preverbs (lefut, átvesz, kicselez, belő)

b2-32-03.title: Communicative Challenge: How the Team Played
b2-32-03.scenario: The goalkeeper asks you why the home team played so well.
b2-32-03.prompt: Tell the goalkeeper how the team played.
cues: Say what the tactics were like
Say what the combination play was like
b2-32-03.target: A csapat taktikája jó volt, a letámadás és az összjáték pedig kiváló.
b2-32-03.english: The team's tactics were good, and the pressing and the combination play were excellent.
b2-32-03.canDo: I can say how a team plays together (taktika, összjáték, letámadás)

b2-32-04.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Defeat
b2-32-04.scenario: After a lost final, Esterházy Péter asks you why it is so hard for the players to get up again.
b2-32-04.prompt: Tell Esterházy why the defeat is so hard to take.
cues: Say what weighs on the players
b2-32-04.target: A lélektani nyomás oly mértékben nagy, hogy a kudarc után nehéz talpra állni.
b2-32-04.english: The psychological pressure is so great that it is hard to get back up after a defeat.
b2-32-04.canDo: I can discuss psychological pressure and mental endurance under competitive conditions

b2-32-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Live from the Pitch
b2-32-05.scenario: Esterházy Péter hands you the microphone for the live broadcast: the winger has the ball.
b2-32-05.prompt: Say the live commentary for the winger's move.
cues: Say that he receives the ball
Say that he dribbles past the goalkeeper
Say that he shoots it in
b2-32-05.target: Itt a szélső: átveszi a labdát, kicselezi a kapust, és belövi!
b2-32-05.english: Here is the winger: he takes the ball, dribbles past the goalkeeper and shoots it in!
b2-32-05.canDo: I can follow and say a short live-commentary sentence (átvesz, kicselez, belő)

b2-32-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Last Minutes
b2-32-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the match, the goalkeeper asks you how the players were in the last minutes.
b2-32-consolidation.prompt: Tell the goalkeeper how the players were.
cues: Say how tired the players were
Say what they could hardly do
b2-32-consolidation.target: A játékosok olyannyira fáradtak voltak, hogy alig tudtak támadni.
b2-32-consolidation.english: The players were so tired that they could hardly attack.
b2-32-consolidation.canDo: I can form result clauses with olyannyira ..., hogy and oly mértékben ..., hogy
